name: vividsites
description: Search cinematic website templates, preview designs, and retrieve build prompts and UI or 3D component code. Each user brings their own paid VividSites library key. This package includes no key and grants no paid-template access.

api_key.label: VividSites API key
api_key.description: Personal key from your own paid VividSites library account at https://www.vividsites.app/mcp. The plugin does not include a key.
